bullets.bullet: The U.S. Energy Information Administration reported that U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela averaged 701,000 b/d in July 2026, the most since May 2017, before falling to 655,000 b/d in August.
The ECB published consolidated banking data for end-June 2026.
